english.description: They may communicate in a strange manner, but these apes can be very loving and passionate.
english.name: L01

english.description: The only primates capable of laying eggs.
english.name: L02

english.description: Their natural habitats include outer space, dreams and rainy cities.
english.name: L03

english.description: Generous by nature, they don't let any member of their group go hungry.
english.name: L04

english.description: They look past appearances: these monkeys look for inner beauty .
english.name: L05

english.description: They are crazy about spotlights, flashes and teen-ape actresses.
english.name: L06

english.description: They hate moving around the jungle on foot.
english.name: L07

english.description: They organize themselves around charismatic and slightly genocidal alpha males.
english.name: L08

english.description: They transform themselves, howl and change their fur with great ease.
english.name: L09

english.description: These monkey put the happiness of their offspring before anything else.
english.name: L10

english.description: They love sports and cleanliness. And, above all, they hate confined spaces.
english.name: L11

english.description: The most creative and talented, although with a certain tendency towards scatology.
english.name: L12

english.description: Monkeys with a passion for natural selection and the struggle between the species.
english.name: L13

english.description: Apes with unimpeachable morality. ABSOLUTELY unimpeachable.
english.name: L14

english.description: Good, caring, empathetic... These primates are morally acceptable.
english.name: L15

english.description: Never trust them: they are the most immoral of all monkeys.
english.name: L16

english.description: Obedient and helpful primates.
english.name: L17

english.description: Very obedient and very helpful primates.
english.name: L18

english.description: The most obedient and helpful monkeys: ALWAYS at the service of their keeper.
english.name: L19

english.description: They go crazy over the most extreme emotions on the boob tube.
english.name: L24

english.description: Half ape, half mole: these primates cannot keep their mouths shut.
english.name: L25

english.description: The most faithful, loyal and discreet primates.
english.name: L26

english.description: They like money almost as much as piggybanks do.
english.name: L27

english.description: Now you see 'em, now you don't: these are the fastest monkeys in the jungle.
english.name: L28

english.description: Big fans of maxing out their credit cards without leaving the tree.
english.name: L29

english.description: Methodical and obsessive: they don't stop until their pencil is worn down to a stub.
english.name: L30

english.description: Their appetite knows no limits. It's a good idea to keep a mop near them.
english.name: L31

english.description: Amateur collectors. They always hold on to something as a souvenir.
english.name: L32

english.description: Experienced collectors. They have a hard time letting go of anything.
english.name: L33

english.description: Compulsive collectors. They hold on to everything, absolutely EVERYTHING.
english.name: L34

schinese.description: 这种类人猿用一种奇怪的方式进行交流，但他们非常有爱心和热情。
schinese.name: L01

schinese.description: 唯一能够下蛋的灵长类动物。
schinese.name: L02

schinese.description: 他们的栖息地是外太空，梦境和多雨的城市。
schinese.name: L03

schinese.description: 他们天生慷慨，确保他们群体中的每一个都有吃的。
schinese.name: L04

schinese.description: 他们穿过外表看本质，这些猴子追求内在美。
schinese.name: L05

schinese.description: 他们对聚光灯，闪光灯和青少年女猴演员都很疯狂。
schinese.name: L06

schinese.description: 他们讨厌光脚在丛林行走。
schinese.name: L07

schinese.description: 他们聚集在具有领导力，攻击力最强的首领猴周围。
schinese.name: L08

schinese.description: 他们会变身，尖叫，并轻松更换他们的皮毛。
schinese.name: L09

schinese.description: 这些猴子将其后代的幸福放在首位。
schinese.name: L10

schinese.description: 他们喜欢运动和清洁，特别讨厌封闭的环境。
schinese.name: L11

schinese.description: 最具创造力和才华，但有点倾向于末世论。
schinese.name: L12

schinese.description: 这些猴子热衷于自然选择和物种之间的斗争。
schinese.name: L13

schinese.description: 具有完美道德的类人猿。完美无瑕。
schinese.name: L14

schinese.description: 良好，关怀，善解人意……这些灵长类动物的道德水平还不错。
schinese.name: L15

schinese.description: 永远不要相信他们，这些猴子的道德水平是最差的。
schinese.name: L16

schinese.description: 顺从而且乐于助人的灵长类动物。
schinese.name: L17

schinese.description: 非常顺从和非常乐于助人的灵长类动物。
schinese.name: L18

schinese.description: 最顺从而且最乐于助人的猴子：准备随时为他们的主人服务。
schinese.name: L19

schinese.description: 他们非常痴迷于观看弱智电视里面的情感戏。
schinese.name: L24

schinese.description: 这些灵长类动物一半像猴子，一半像鼹鼠，总是叽喳不停。
schinese.name: L25

schinese.description: 最忠诚，老实，谨慎的灵长类动物。
schinese.name: L26

schinese.description: 他们非常喜欢钱，就像存钱罐喜欢硬币一样。
schinese.name: L27

schinese.description: 他们在丛林中一会儿出现，一会儿又消失了，他们是最快的猴子。
schinese.name: L28

schinese.description: 非常喜欢待在树上就能刷爆信用卡。
schinese.name: L29

schinese.description: 有条理，有强迫症，他们在铅笔用完之前不会停止。
schinese.name: L30

schinese.description: 他们有无法满足的胃口。如果他们在旁边，最好随时备有拖把。
schinese.name: L31

schinese.description: 业余收藏家，总是留着一些纪念品。
schinese.name: L32

schinese.description: 老练的收藏家，不愿意丢掉东西。
schinese.name: L33

schinese.description: 强迫症收藏家，总是会留着所有的东西。所有一切东西。
schinese.name: L34
